decisions.rationale: SD-DIST-CLI: The installed main facade only parses/forwards argv to the unchanged notes/preview adapters and reports the distribution version. Command dispatch and entry-point installation are protocol mechanics, not domain eligibility or authority decisions.

SD-DIST-RESOURCES: Explicit setuptools mappings include the existing runtime modules and fixed HTTP assets; skill_contents reads version-matched package resources. This is artifact assembly/resource I-O, not a new decision policy. Installed smoke checks all four served assets against wheel bytes and imports outside the developer checkout.

SD-DIST-DATA: The installed adapter delegates to the unchanged NotesStore/API. Consumer workspace selection, immutable file snapshots, exact-byte quotations and revision compare-and-swap are preserved persistence mechanics; packaging does not invent a parallel lifecycle policy. Fresh installed processes and a rejected stale write exercise those existing boundaries.

SD-DIST-SKILL: install_skill exports a fixed resource set only to an explicit destination. Matching-byte idempotence, exclusive creation and refusal to overwrite differing files are filesystem conflict handling, not semantic authorization. Separate portable resources preserve the historical review-bound repository skill; no global agent configuration is changed.

SD-DIST-COMPAT: The installed preview facade calls the same create_server/NotesPreview/display_state path, reusing the existing stale/unavailable/empty snapshot and continuity Specifications. Loopback sockets, fixed read-only routes and absence of a canonical writer are preserved adapter boundaries, not new publication authority. Source tests and installed HTTP probes cover the unchanged behavior; a complete supervisor is deliberately not packaged.
